status: Installed-synth DLS loop rules applied to decoded effective region loops

references.use: Read-only static inspection (Apple llvm-objdump); no code, binary or PCM imported
observations: wsmp loops store start and start+length as unsigned 32-bit values without range checks
A wave keeps frames+1 samples; the link writes the guard as a copy of the loop start (zero for one-shots, whose length then excludes it)
Wave verification clamps end to [1, frames+1], start to <= end, one-shot under five frames
The link copies wave settings into regions without wsmp and restarts a start >= frames+1 at zero
Region verification repeats the clamp, one-shot under six frames
Voices use 20.12 fixed-point start/end and subtract end-start on reaching the end

references.use: Identified by its strings as AudioMan 1.8 (wave mixer); not the DLS synthesizer

replacement_code: src/engine/dls_bank.cpp: msynth_effective_loop and authored/effective region loops
src/engine/dls_sampler.cpp: guard-position reads equal the loop start sample
src/app/inspector_world_sounds.cpp: authored and effective loop inspection
deliberate_limits: Interpolation at the guard position uses the loop start instead of the original one-past-buffer read
A short-loop one-shot does not play the original's trailing guard frame
Other MSynth25 clamps (unity note, fine tune, attenuation, rate) are not adopted; the decoder's structural refusals remain
